<function name="GetLadders" parent="CNavArea" type="classfunc">
	<description>
Returns all <page>CNavLadder</page>s that have a ( one or two way ) connection **from** this <page>CNavArea</page>.

See <page>CNavArea:GetLaddersAtSide</page> for a function that only returns <page>CNavLadder</page>s in given direction.
	</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="table<CNavLadder>">The <page>CNavLadder</page>s that have a ( one or two way ) connection **from** this <page>CNavArea</page>.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
